reviews.review: Playing this after Update 2, which from what i heard is a massive improvement. So far my initial reaction is its not bad. the enviorment seems kinda empty but there is a decent art style here. But gunplay is fun (i want more guns), some of the abilities seem really gimicky and some seem more useful than others. layla seems to be the choice because her abilities seem OP compared to others. i get steady framerate 85% of the time. framerate hickups alot when im traveling on foot to new areas, story seems shallow but its not as bad as gollem lol ill give this 65/100 as of update 2

With the resent update to redfall I decided to buy it. The game is fun, I played it solo. I did not get board and I didn't find it repetitive. The game play itself is basic and nothing special but the gun play is fun and works. The boss fights are like any other game. I did not face any bugs with my time playing redfall. I think personally this game is way over hated, its a fun survival shooter. Now I recommend buying this game when it's on sale because it's just another shooter. But I want to say this game is fun and deserves a tiny bit of love.

At $70, it's overpriced, but at $30, it's worth considering.
I played through the game once, reaching level 18 with 12 hours of gameplay. 
Performance was good after updating drivers and optimizing settings with GeForce Experience.
Annoyingly, FoV adjustments required manual editing.
The gameplay loop resembles Far Cry, minus vehicles.
Combat is similar to Doom with exploiting enemy weaknesses but less enjoyable.
Abilities felt like Overwatch that got better as you leveled them, but felt balanced.
Leveling is decent, though I only reached level 18 of 40.
Item management is swapping out weapons quickly lose power as you level, the world scales with you.

Overall, I think it's an enjoyable game. I won't be playing through it again though. I would recommend it if the price is right.
